svg.aria-label: Real DNA-fluorescence image and analysis. Image: David Root / CellProfiler, distributed through scikit-image, CC0. A and B use identical display ranges; green contours mark smoothed regions above threshold 45 and at least 40 pixels in area. C retains the raw histogram. D shows threshold sensitivity. Coordinates are pixels; no missing physical calibration is inferred.
